content: Human-labeling session — f11-rebuild-after-attrition:medium seed 1. Objective: Commander, you hold two bases. A HOME base in the deep west around (12,20) has the full production stack — Construction Yard, Power Plants, Ore Refinery, Barracks, War Factory, Helipad, Service Depot — plus two Harvesters and two Medium Tanks on hold-fire. A FORWARD War Factory sits exposed near (50,20); it is at low health and four enemy heavy tanks are already engaging it. Around tick 2500 a rocket-soldier raid arrives at mid-map. An enemy base sits at (82,20), defended by riflemen and a rocket soldier. Cash on hand: $8000. Win bar: at the deadline you must have a War Factory standing, at least four Medium Tanks alive, AND have razed at least two enemy buildings — all within about 115 turns. Keep your HOME Construction Yard standing.
